title: Finding the Edge: Behind the Scenes as We Test the Future of Gravel in Squamish
content:
We took a fleet of progressive gravel bikes to BC to find out where gravel bikes are heading. Join the Velo tech team for sketchy singletrack, ramen, and a lot of arguing about bike categories.

Read the full article at Finding the Edge: Behind the Scenes as We Test the Future of Gravel in Squamish on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
